ShortDescription.Value: Play however your brain wants. The mod remembers the rest.

Publish.LongDescription:
# ADHD gone wild
Start a highway. Suddenly build a metro station. Abandon it. Decorate a park. Never go back to the highway.
None of that is a problem to be fixed. This mod exists so none of it has to be held in your head.
It is not a productivity tool. No tasks, no streaks, no scores, and nothing that counts what you did not finish.
## What it does
- **Park an idea** - Ctrl+I, then click anywhere. A ring marks the spot; click the ring later and it opens. - **One short list** instead of the same warning on forty buildings. Mute anything you would rather not hear about, and unmute it whenever you like. - **A safety net** - one click saves a way back before you try something, one click returns. - **Welcome back** - where you were, and what you left there. - **A calmer screen** - map icons stop pulsing, and the build toolbar folds away. - **It mentions the time** - every couple of hours, the clock and how long you have been playing. It never suggests stopping.
Everything can be switched off on its own. Nothing is written into your save games. English, French and Italian.
## Early days
This is a first release and the mod is nowhere near finished. Plenty is still planned, some of what is here will change, and a few things are certainly rough.
**Please leave a comment.** What helps, what gets in the way, what you wish it did. And if you have ADHD, how any of this actually lands for you - that is worth more to me than a bug report, because it is the part I cannot work out on my own.
## Thanks
To my girlfriend, and to her ADHD. Between them they shaped this mod far more than I did.
Publish.ChangeLog:
First release.
- Park an idea anywhere on the map and come back to it later, with a marker you can see. - Smart alerts: one row per kind of problem instead of one icon per building, with mute and unmute. - Creative safety net: a one-click checkpoint, and a one-click way back from it. - Welcome back: where you were, and what you left there. - Calm UI: notification icons held still, and a build toolbar that folds away. - Hyperfocus reminders: the wall clock and how long you have been playing. - Colour-blind friendly palette, and every feature switchable on its own. - English, French and Italian.
